verdict: The daily top 4, held with tp40-t40, is the walk-forward exit with the highest deduped mean (26.7%). On the holdout that mean is 33.7%, the median is 0.1%, the same-month same-volatility random mean is 5.9%, and the same predicted-volatility random mean is 1.1%. The holdout mean is 27.7% above that volatility-matched random stock. Capping every trade at +100% cuts the walk-forward mean from 26.7% to 1.7% and the holdout mean from 33.7% to 0.9%. The uncapped mean is a thin gap tail, not the typical trade. From the entry, 31.5% of top-4 names reach a +30% high within 20 sessions and 28.5% reach a -30% low, against 20.3% and 16.6% for the volatility-matched names. Forward volatility is 129.4% against 124.3%. Once volatility is matched, the upside and downside tails are close. The model is largely selecting high-volatility names. 16.9% of the upside top 4 are also top-4 picks of the mirror model trained on a -30% low. Holdout top-4 lift is 4.97 with the option features and 5.17 with trailing return and volatility only. Removing the option-flow features leaves most of the lift in place. The four-name holdout portfolio has CAGR 85.7%, max drawdown -17.5%, and Sharpe 1.22, against SPY at 12.4%, -9.2%, and 0.91.
